DecisionType.description: Section 9.19 states possible Decision types include these values; it does not freeze a closed universal enum.

DecisionOutcome.description: Appendix E.19 references DecisionOutcome as a formal type but does not freeze a closed universal value set.

TransitionResult.description: Appendix E.24 references TransitionResult as a formal type but does not freeze a closed universal value set.

TraceEventType.description: Appendix E.25 references TraceEventType as a formal type but does not freeze a closed universal value set.

MessageType.description: Section 10.50 says reference message types MAY include these values; therefore this type remains extensible.
